workflow: MANDATORY_EXIT_TRIGGERED -> EXIT_ORDER_SUBMITTED -> EXIT_PARTIALLY_FILLED -> EXIT_FULLY_FILLED -> BROKER_RECONCILED -> CAPITAL_AVAILABLE -> REPLACEMENT_EVALUATION -> REPLACEMENT_AUTHORIZED -> REPLACEMENT_ORDER_SUBMITTED (or HELD_CASH)

guarantees.exit_never_gated: Replacement reacts only AFTER the mandatory exit has fully filled AND broker-reconciled; it never gates/delays the exit.
guarantees.no_immediate_reentry: A no-reentry cooldown excludes the just-stopped-out symbol (and any symbol still cooling) from replacement selection even if eligible.
guarantees.qualification: Replacement candidates must pass the existing ReplacementEligibility gates (seller exhaustion, positive momentum, DI+/BB/VWAP, liquidity, regime) + downstream native authorization.

verdict: Replacement workflow operational; reconciliation-gated; no forced reinvestment; no uncontrolled re-entry.
